name: Espresso Tonic

ingredients.name: chilled tonic water, plus more if desired

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large glass with ice. Add tonic water to glass. Brew espresso and pour on top. Sweeten to taste (about 1/2 teaspoon at a time) with syrup and/or add more tonic to taste, if desired. Garnish with lemon peel, if desired. Serve right away.

description: This popular iced espresso drink is refreshing and fizzy thanks to the addition of tonic water. It's easy to make and easily adaptable to a number of different flavorings.
notes:
Optional or for serving: Simple syrup or oleo-saccharum, to taste (optional, see notes); Lemon peel (optional, see notes)

Optional substitutions: freshly brewed shot espresso → strongly brewed coffee

Notes: Tonic water is already sweetened, so whether you want additional sweetness, and how much, is up to you. This drink is highly adaptable, so feel free to play with syrups with different flavor profiles: While simple syrup is neutral, other options like oleo-saccharum (lemon syrup), maple syrup, and more can work great.
Garnishes and flavorings are similarly optional. Lemon peel pairs nicely with this drink, but a couple drops of orange flower water, grapefruit zest, and many other flavorings are possible. Have fun with it!
author: Daniel Gritzer
